capabilities.title: Display session
capabilities.detail: Native Wayland session (wayland-0) on KDE. XWayland is also available (:0); X11-only tools see only X11 windows, never native Wayland ones.

capabilities.title: Desktop portal service
capabilities.detail: Running with backend(s): gtk, kde, kwallet, plasmanotify.

capabilities.title: Screen capture (ScreenCast portal)
capabilities.detail: Host interface v5; source types: monitor, window, virtual. A portal client needs an OS share grant. Hutch's existing-desktop portal adapter is not implemented.
capabilities.fix: Use the reviewed isolated KWin mode; this discovery does not test capture.

capabilities.title: Input injection (RemoteDesktop portal)
capabilities.detail: Interface v2 (ConnectToEIS available); devices: keyboard, pointer, touchscreen. Input is seat-wide: approving it is not scoped to one window. Capture and input are separate grants.
capabilities.fix: Host discovery only: Hutch has no existing-desktop portal input adapter.

capabilities.title: PipeWire
capabilities.detail: Daemon socket present and libpipewire installed.

capabilities.title: libei (emulated input)
capabilities.detail: libei is installed. Hutch obtains EIS from its private KWin session; input still needs a delivered-action test.

capabilities.title: Accessibility tree (AT-SPI)
capabilities.detail: The accessibility bus is running, but this Python environment has no GObject bindings (gi).
capabilities.fix: Install python-gobject (and gir1.2-atspi / at-spi2-core typelibs) for Hutch's interpreter, or run the accessibility adapter out of process.

capabilities.title: Clipboard
capabilities.detail: Host tools found: wl-copy, wl-paste. Hutch does not expose clipboard read/write or mount the personal clipboard into its private session.

capabilities.title: Third-party input tools
capabilities.detail: None installed. Hutch uses the private KWin EIS channel after session review, never a privileged input daemon.

capabilities.title: Isolated KWin prerequisites
capabilities.detail: KWin virtual/capture/containment tools and libei are present. Package presence is not a capture or input test; a reviewed run checks its private display and EIS separately.
capabilities.fix: Enable computer applications and review a new session. A PyGObject interpreter, usable user namespaces and the user service manager are also required.

capabilities.title: Browser engine
capabilities.detail: Headless launch in a throwaway profile worked in 0.6s.

capabilities.title: Human step control
capabilities.detail: Bounded human frames and step input are available for owned Chromium and private KWin sessions. Per-assistant computer access defaults off; paired viewing needs Monitor, input needs Review and an explicit controller lease. Physical phones and live remote networks remain unverified.
capabilities.fix: Enable Computer access in assistant settings, then start a new supported run. Use the existing private HTTPS/passkey deployment; this feature opens no listener.
capabilities.evidence: local Chromium/KWin input tests; viewport emulation

summary.note: Hutch implements isolated KWin sessions. Portal discovery describes host interfaces, not an implemented existing-desktop adapter. Session review, capture and delivered input are separate checks.
